title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: no halt in 4.0·10^17 steps, words as blocks
text: Keeping the words as blocks that the Lean sweep rules cross in one move, the simulation runs 399,758,169,806,655,314 steps from blank tape without a halt (tape 610,949,829 cells). It matches the flat-tape version at all 160,976 left-end returns in the first 10^12 steps.
